Joe Root reappointed England Test captain, Stephen Fleming named coach

Joe Root has been reappointed as the captain of the England Test cricket team. Stephen Fleming has been appointed as the new head coach for the Test team. Root expressed excitement about leading the next generation of players. Fleming's appointment comes as the team seeks to move forward under new leadership.
